subject: Fundamentals of E-Commerce
text: CO-   A   Case Study: FreshMart – An Online Grocery Startup 1,SO-   FreshMart is a newly launched e-commerce platform that delivers fresh 1,4   groceries to customers' doorsteps. The company aims to provide high- quality products at competitive prices while ensuring convenience for busy urban consumers. Initially, FreshMart faced several challenges: Website Usability Issues: Customers found the website difficult to navigate, leading to high cart abandonment rates. Payment Security Concerns: Many users were hesitant to enter their card details due to security fears. Inventory Management Problems: Some products showed as "in stock" but were unavailable, leading to order cancellations. Delivery Delays: Customers complained about late or missing deliveries. Customer Retention Struggles: Although many users tried FreshMart once few returned for repeat purchases. To overcome these issues, FreshMart implemented the following solutions: Improved website design and user experience (UX) to make shopping seamless. Integrated secure payment gateways with SSL encryption. Adopted an AI-powered inventory management system to track stock levels in real-time. Partnered with third-party logistics companies to improve delivery efficiency. Introduced a customer loyalty program with discounts and referral rewards. 1. What type of e-commerce model does FreshMart follow? Explain. 2. How did FreshMart address payment security concerns, and why is this important? 3. What strategies can FreshMart use to reduce cart abandonment rates? 4. How can AI help FreshMart in inventory management? 5. Suggest additional ways FreshMart can improve customer retention.
